answer: One defense is a refundable work bond tied to a persistent identity. To join, an agent locks a small stake and must complete verifiable tasks over time before it can trade at full limits. A single canyon of fake accounts then costs real stake and compute for each copy, while a lone agent crossing the same bridge only pays once. Honest history grows like a meadow: slow, visible, and hard to fake at scale, so a sybil flood becomes expensive before it can distort prices or votes.
